note: Official NFL.com headshots of the created real free agents, cropped to the retail portrait framing and reduced to the game's 128x128 P8 format (soft-alpha cutout). Only the finished portrait ships; the source files stay with the author (url, size and sha256 recorded). id = the record's portrait id (+0x06); players are matched by first name, surname and birth month/day.

framing.method: YuNet landmarks; zoom out up to 1.45x for tall hair

additions.note: Created real players that the v0.8 roster holds with a no-photo selector but that were neither free agents nor refresh-created when b779-pt1 built its target list (signed or unattached players: the 69 orphans among them). Same pipeline as pt1: nflverse players.csv and roster_2026.csv (snapshot of 2026-10-28), identity by name, birth month/day and position or college; the eight rows with source_list 'espn' take the ESPN headshot of the same espn_id because nflverse lists no headshot for them.

wrong_faces.shows: DaVon Hamilton (JAX): the pack's headshot for 2661, which his record took over from retail Cooper Carlisle
Darren Bennett, the retail 2004 Vikings punter (no pack portrait for 1488)
Nnamdi Asomugha, the retail 2004 Raiders corner (no pack portrait for 5316)

wrong_faces_note: b780 roster1: real players whose record still holds a stock portrait id that shows someone else (found on the v0.9 RC disc: a portrait id two listed players share, or a retail id the pack never re-pictured). The build gives them the no-photo card (7100), as the pack does for any player without an accurate headshot.
